CustomField.description: When enabled in a sandbox, changes made by nominated deployment users can be treated as deployment-window compliant without requiring an approved Deployment Window. Changes made by other users remain subject to normal Deployment Window checks.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Use this option for sandboxes with frequent deployments. It applies only to nominated deployment users and does not disable setup-change monitoring or other governance checks.
CustomField.label: Skip Deployment Windows for Sandbox
